record.name: Zabrak Dathomirian
record.description: Dathomirian Zabraks are Force-sensitive Zabraks from the dark world of Dathomir, where they have been influenced by the Nightsisters and dark side energies. They possess enhanced Force sensitivity and a natural affinity for dark side powers.

innate_traits.name: Dark Side Affinity
innate_traits.narrative: Your connection to Dathomir's dark energies flows through your very being, making you naturally intimidating and resistant to fear. The dark side of the Force resonates with your soul, granting you power that other Zabraks cannot comprehend.

mechanics.name: Dark Intimidation
mechanics.description: You have advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks.

mechanics.name: Fear Resistance
mechanics.description: You have resistance to fear effects.

mechanics.name: Fear Immunity
mechanics.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

innate_traits.name: Enhanced Force Sensitivity
innate_traits.narrative: Dathomir's dark energies have heightened your Force sensitivity beyond that of ordinary Zabraks. You can sense emotions and Force currents with incredible clarity, and your connection to the dark side makes your Force powers more potent.

mechanics.name: Emotional Sensing
mechanics.description: You have advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to sense emotions.

mechanics.name: Dark Side Enhancement
mechanics.description: Once per short rest, you can gain advantage on a Force power check.

innate_traits.name: Nightsister Heritage
innate_traits.narrative: Your connection to the Nightsister traditions runs deep in your blood. You possess ancient knowledge of dark side Force powers and can sense the presence of other Force users with incredible precision.

mechanics.name: Dark Side Knowledge
mechanics.description: You have advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks related to dark side Force powers.

mechanics.name: Force User Detection
mechanics.description: You can sense the presence of other Force users within 30 feet.

appearance_profile.llm_description_prompt: Describe a Zabrak Dathomirian character. Emphasize their dark side aura and the way their horns seem to pulse with dark side energy, suggesting their connection to Dathomir's dark energies and Nightsister heritage. Their features should reflect the influence of dark side energies and their enhanced Force sensitivity. Consider their intense nature and the way they carry themselves with the confident, dark side bearing of someone who has been touched by Dathomir's mystical energies.

class_synergies.narrative: Zabrak Dathomirian's natural dark side abilities and Enhanced Force Sensitivity make them exceptional Guardians, using their dark side powers to protect and dominate.
mechanical_benefits: Dark Side Affinity trait enhances intimidation and protective abilities
Enhanced Force Sensitivity trait improves Force power usage
Nightsister Heritage trait enables threat detection

class_synergies.narrative: Zabrak Dathomirian's natural mystical abilities and dark side connection make them excellent Consulars, using their dark side powers to manipulate and control situations.
mechanical_benefits: Dark Side Affinity trait enhances intimidation and manipulation
Enhanced Force Sensitivity trait improves Force-based diplomacy
Nightsister Heritage trait aids in understanding others

class_synergies.narrative: Zabrak Dathomirian's natural mystical knowledge and dark side connection make them excellent Scholars, particularly in dark side studies and Force traditions.
mechanical_benefits: Nightsister Heritage trait provides insights into dark side powers
Enhanced Force Sensitivity trait enhances Force-related research
Dark Side Affinity trait supports dark side studies

class_synergies.narrative: Zabrak Dathomirian's natural mystical abilities and dark side connection make them excellent Scouts, able to sense and navigate using their dark side powers.
mechanical_benefits: Enhanced Force Sensitivity trait enables detection of Force users
Nightsister Heritage trait enhances mystical navigation
Dark Side Affinity trait supports dark side exploration

faction_synergies.narrative: Zabrak Dathomirians are closely connected to the Nightsisters of Dathomir, using their dark side abilities and Nightsister heritage to serve their dark side traditions.
Many Zabrak Dathomirians join various dark side traditions and cults, dedicating themselves to the study and mastery of dark side powers.
Some Zabrak Dathomirians prefer to work independently, using their dark side abilities and mystical heritage to pursue their own dark side goals and ambitions.

level_5.description: Your dark side affinity becomes more refined, allowing you to channel Dathomir's dark energies with greater precision.
level_5.mechanical_benefit: Increase the range of Force user detection from 30 feet to 60 feet, and gain advantage on Intimidation checks when using dark side powers.

level_10.description: Your enhanced Force sensitivity reaches new heights, allowing you to sense and manipulate dark side energies more effectively.
level_10.mechanical_benefit: You can use your action to gain advantage on all Wisdom-based skill checks for the next minute when using dark side powers or in mystical environments.

level_15.description: Your Nightsister heritage allows you to channel dark side energies into devastating attacks.
level_15.mechanical_benefit: When using dark side Force powers, you gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls, representing your enhanced dark side mastery.

level_20.description: Your dark side affinity reaches its peak, making you nearly immune to light side influences and allowing you to sense dark side disturbances across great distances.
level_20.mechanical_benefit: You have advantage on all saving throws against light side effects, and you can sense major dark side disturbances within 1 mile.

cultural_features.description: Zabrak Dathomirians practice sacred dark side rituals that channel Dathomir's dark energies and strengthen their connection to the dark side.
cultural_features.name: Dark Side Rituals
cultural_features.activation: Upon reaching level 5, after completing a meditation session focused on connecting with the dark side.
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: As you perform the ritual, you feel the dark side energy coursing through your veins. Your connection to the force grows stronger, and you sense the presence of dark side artifacts and energies nearby.

cultural_features.description: Nightsister traditions emphasize mastery of dark side powers, mystical arts, and the importance of maintaining dark side connections and knowledge.
cultural_features.name: Nightsister Traditions
cultural_features.activation: Upon reaching level 10, after completing a training session focused on mastering dark side powers.
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: As you delve deeper into the Nightsisters' traditions, you begin to see visions of your future as a powerful Force-user. Your connection to the dark side grows stronger, and you sense the presence of mystical forces guiding your path.

cultural_features.description: Dathomir heritage traditions celebrate the connection to the dark world and its mystical energies, strengthening bonds with the dark side.
cultural_features.name: Dathomir Heritage
cultural_features.activation: Upon reaching level 15, after completing a celebration focused on honoring Dathomir's dark side energies.
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: As you honor your Dathomir heritage, you feel a deep connection to the dark side and its mystical forces. Your senses grow sharper, and you sense the presence of powerful Force-users nearby.

cultural_features.description: Zabrak Dathomirians practice meditation techniques that enhance their connection to the dark side and strengthen their mystical abilities.
cultural_features.name: Dark Side Meditation
cultural_features.activation: Upon reaching level 20, after completing a deep meditation session focused on connecting with the dark side.
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: As you meditate, you feel your connection to the force grow stronger. Your senses are heightened, and you sense the presence of all living beings in the galaxy. You realize your true potential as a Force-user and understand your role in shaping the galaxy's destiny.

environmental_adaptations.description: Your connection to the dark side allows you to thrive in environments rich with dark side energy and mystical forces.
environmental_adaptations.mechanical_benefit: You have advantage on all skill checks in dark side environments, and you can sense the presence of dark side artifacts or locations.

environmental_adaptations.description: Your mystical connection allows you to sense and navigate mystical environments with ease.
environmental_adaptations.mechanical_benefit: You have advantage on saving throws against mystical effects, and you can sense the presence of mystical entities within 30 feet.

environmental_adaptations.description: Your enhanced Force sensitivity allows you to sense and understand Force-rich environments with incredible clarity.
environmental_adaptations.mechanical_benefit: You have advantage on Intelligence-based skill checks in Force-rich environments, and you can sense disturbances in the Force within 1 mile.

environmental_adaptations.description: Your dark side affinity makes you resistant to corruption and dark side influences that would corrupt others.
environmental_adaptations.mechanical_benefit: You have advantage on saving throws against corruption effects, and you can sense the presence of corrupting influences.

progression_balance: Species progression enhancements focus on dark side abilities and mystical powers, complementing rather than overshadowing class features
Nightsister heritage and dark side affinity improvements maintain the species' unique identity while providing meaningful advancement
Mystical and dark side abilities provide situational advantages without making the species universally superior
cultural_integration: Cultural features focus on Nightsister traditions and dark side culture rather than mechanical advantages
Dark side rituals and Nightsister traditions provide unique roleplaying opportunities and cultural depth
Dathomir heritage and dark side meditation enhance character development and party dynamics
environmental_specialization: Environmental adaptations are specifically designed for dark side and mystical environments where Nightsister abilities are valuable
Advantages are situational and thematic, maintaining game balance while enhancing immersion
Corruption resistance and Force sensitivity provide unique utility without overshadowing other species' abilities

overrides.secondary_nemesis: Other Nightsisters, who may view them as threats to their power or see potential in their abilities

romance_progression.stage2: The player begins to see a softer side of the nemesis, but still senses a darkness lurking beneath.

relationship_styles: Intense and passionate, built on a foundation of mutual respect and trust
Forbidden love, between two outcasts forced together by circumstance
courtship_rituals: A ritualistic 'binding' ceremony, where the couple is tied together through dark side energies

record.flavor_text: Dathomirian Zabraks are a breed apart from their horned kin, forged in the dark energies of Dathomir. Born to mothers who have walked the twisted paths of the Nightsisters' power, they are often shunned by their own kind for their unnatural affinity for the dark side. Yet, it is this very bond with the darkness that makes them formidable Force-sensitives, capable of wielding powers both feared and reviled throughout the galaxy.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: When playing a Dathomirian Zabrak, remember that their connection to the dark side is not just a natural talent, but also a heavy burden. They have been taught by the Nightsisters that strength lies in embracing one's darker emotions, and this can lead to a volatile mix of raw power and emotional turmoil. Theirs is a world where might makes right, and those who cannot or will not wield darkness are often cast out.
narrative_hooks: The calling of the dark side is strong within you...
A Nightsister's prophecy foretells your destiny...
llm_guidance.social_dynamics: Dathomirian Zabraks are often isolated from their own kind, seen as unclean by some and a necessary evil by others. As a result, they may be drawn to outsiders or those who understand them, forming tight bonds with those few who can see beyond their dark reputation.
common_motivations: Seeking power and recognition in a galaxy that fears and shuns them
Uncovering the secrets of their mysterious heritage

secondary_motivations: Seek out new sources of power

loyalty_triggers.trigger_event: A rival seeks to usurp my power
loyalty_triggers.response: I will not stand idly by...

services.name: Dark Side Focus
services.description: Maintain your focus on the dark side, increasing your ability to cast Force powers.
